name: Southshore
summary: In Hillsbrad, Southshore shelters the Alliance amid the ruins of Lordaeron. Once a quiet fishing village, the coastal port now faces the Forsaken at Tarren Mill, Syndicate bandits, and monsters along the shore.

sections.title: A Beacon in Lordaeron
sections.body:
Refugee boats from the fallen kingdom of Stormwind first brought Southshore to prominence during the First War. The town was contested and overrun during the Second War, then rebuilt. It endured the horrors of the Third War as well.

Now much of Lordaeron lies in ruins or under Forsaken rule, but Southshore remains loyal to the Grand Alliance. It shelters displaced human survivors, veteran paladins of the Silver Hand, and scholars of the Kirin Tor.

sections.title: Besieged on All Fronts
sections.body:
Southshore's docks see the ship between Menethil Harbor and Auberdine, and the town is known for its turtle bisque. Yet life here is perilous. Magistrate Henry Maleb and Marshal Redpath lead the town as it faces pressure from every side.

To the north, the Forsaken of Tarren Mill fight a bitter border conflict for control of Hillsbrad. Inland, Syndicate outlaws raid supply lines and assassinate local leaders. Ogres, murlocs, and naga also harass the town's borders.

faq.q: Why is Southshore still aligned with the Alliance when Lordaeron fell?
faq.answer: The Scourge's invasion spared Southshore from total destruction. Its surviving humans renewed their historic oaths to the Grand Alliance, and Stormwind provides military and logistical support to keep a foothold in the north.

faq.q: Why is there such intense fighting between Southshore and Tarren Mill?
aliases: why do southshore and tarren mill fight
faq.answer: Tarren Mill is held by the Forsaken, while Southshore is the region's chief Alliance stronghold. Both factions claim the Hillsbrad Foothills, so border skirmishes, raids, and sabotage are frequent.

faq.q: Who leads the town of Southshore?
faq.answer: Magistrate Henry Maleb handles civil governance. He took over after the Syndicate assassinated the previous magistrate. Marshal Redpath directs the town's defense and security.

faq.q: What threats does Southshore face other than the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Southshore faces coastal murlocs and naga, Crushridge ogres from the Alterac Mountains, and the Syndicate, whose base is Durnholde Keep.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you find a haven and military stronghold in northern Lordaeron at Southshore. It offers support against the Forsaken and the Syndicate.
For the Horde, especially the Forsaken at nearby Tarren Mill, Southshore is an obstinate Alliance enclave on land reclaimed by the dead.
